data.title: Markets News, Aug. 20, 2026: Major Indexes Slide After Snapping 3-Day Skids; Oil Prices, Treasury Yields, Bitcoin Rise; Walmart Stock Drops
data.description: Major U.S. stock indexes slumped on Thursday, a day after they snapped three-session losing streaks, as Walmart shares tumbled. Meanwhile, bitcoin, oil prices, and Treasury yields rose.
